conventions.protocol: Serialized requests, responses, events, versions, and taxonomies live in browser-safe @risuai/protocol subpaths.
conventions.sharedRuntime: Only framework-neutral leaf behavior may enter an audited shared runtime package; it cannot depend on Svelte, DOM, Fastify, Node hosts, persistence, or aggregate Database state.
conventions.server: Security, active-writer policy, persistence, credentials, filesystem, process, and host behavior remain under server/fastify.
conventions.fixtures: Historical compatibility fixtures remain test-owned; shared fixture data may move without moving browser application modules into a server dependency.

protocol-wire-contract.migrationPhase: Workstream 1 Phase 1, then consuming Phase 4/5 slice
protocol-wire-contract.reviewTrigger: Protocol parity is proven and all consumers use the explicit package subpath.

shared-pure-runtime.migrationPhase: Workstream 1 Phase 3, then consuming Phase 4/5 slice
shared-pure-runtime.reviewTrigger: A neutral leaf extraction passes browser/server parity and the shared import audit.

browser-application-model.targetOwner: narrow protocol/shared domain input plus runtime-owned adapter
browser-application-model.reviewTrigger: The server consumer no longer needs a browser aggregate or application model declaration.

test-fixture.targetOwner: runtime-neutral test fixture adjacent to its owning lane
test-fixture.reviewTrigger: The fixture is moved or the retained test-only exception receives an explicit closeout decision.

server-only-extraction.reviewTrigger: The server-owned behavior no longer imports its browser implementation.

accidental-browser-support.reviewTrigger: Equivalent neutral support exists or the exception is explicitly retained at closeout.

projectReferences.purpose: Makes current browser-tree types available to Fastify/browser-smoke strict typechecks.
projectReferences.removalPhase: Workstream 1 Phase 6 after every requiring edge is migrated.
projectReferences.reviewTrigger: The cross-runtime edge inventory reaches zero for consumers requiring emitted client declarations.
